How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: happy i choose to live by myself. And not as a part of the housing.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: If you are a bit older, I am personally 26 when I left, and did not want to share a bedroom with someone who is 18. Or even just share tbh. I think living by myself made it a bit more an independent trip. And a little diffrent then the typical exchange/college experince some people want.
